basis: Calculated outline allowances; scenario ranges are neither quotations nor confidence quantiles. Existing pilot capital and operating accounts are retained, partitioned once, and supplemented by explicitly disjoint provisions.

project_finance_layers.financing: Excluded from unlevered real economic NPV; requires drawdown, interest, debt and financing policy.
project_finance_layers.taxes: Excluded; tax treatment and recoverability require project-specific policy.
project_finance_layers.customs: Excluded; item origins, tariff classifications and exemptions remain unresolved.
project_finance_layers.exchange_rate: USD scenario accounting; no conversion or exchange-rate hedge has been applied.
project_finance_layers.nonfare_revenue: No revenue or speculative resale/salvage credit applied.
